name: Takamine Fujino
source:
A girl whose height is very high, higher than anyone in the school.
Originally weak and retracted, it gradually became more active as the height increased. In fact, She think her hight height isn't feminin. She has a huge complex about it. Sometimes, it also happening she hit  her head against the edge of the doors at home.

"There is not anyone who would get me as his bride in this way ... hahaha ..."
